question: Do the independently selected Demis, Elon, and Jensen faction-truth corrections remain bounded when they coexist, without creating a new faction, strategy, backend, action-choice, or matchup failure?

retiredAttempts.reason: The clean interaction report omitted the preregistered action-diversity and winning-path-diversity diagnostics. Its faction standings remain descriptive, but the seed is retired and cannot select the package.

factionTruth.demis: All Compute, Research reliability, Capability, and technical threshold attainment remain canonical. Only late public recognition changes.
factionTruth.elon: Infrastructure velocity and the Facility discount remain canonical. Mandate appears only when the discount actually reduces a completed Facility cost.
factionTruth.jensen: Starting Compute, every New Architecture offer, accepted license, Runway payment, rival Compute grant, and the three-Compute ceiling remain canonical. Jensen's own allocation depends on realized rival demand.
factionTruth.eligibility: Reject any package that weakens a protected strength, changes an unrelated faction rule, or makes Build or Research materially more compulsory.

requiredDiagnostics: configuration-specific faction standings at three, four, and five players
common-seed paired faction win-share, score, and rank deltas
Demis late-validation Mandate withheld and technical realization
Elon Industrial Velocity uses, actual savings, Mandate, and Build selection
Jensen New Architecture offers, licenses, payments, rival Compute, and self-Compute
faction-strategy, faction-backend, strategy-backend, and head-to-head cells

selectionRule.packageAuthority: This experiment validates interactions among three independently selected levers. It cannot establish a new causal effect or substitute for their isolated receipts.
selectionRule.fourPlayer: Select only if all six factions remain in a plausible leading or counterplay band at the four-player balance authority, no registered dominance appears, and the corrections move Demis, Elon, and Jensen in their isolated directions.
selectionRule.threeAndFive: Reject an integrity failure, credible dominance regression, reversal of a selected lever, or materially worse count discontinuity at three or five.
selectionRule.actionChoice: Reject if Elon's Build selection or Demis's Research selection materially rises relative to canonical, or if any Core Action collapses into compulsory use.
selectionRule.samBoundary: Do not infer a Sam rules correction solely from pooled policies; separately report Power Broker realization because willing-partner skill is Sam's intended bottleneck.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, standing mismatch, missing package classification, or missing realization metric rejects the package.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical rule changes without this tracked receipt, synchronized immutable candidate work, explicit user approval, and controlled physical testing.
